basic_details.short_information: Central University of Punjab (CUP), Bathinda offers one purely temporary Field Assistant post at ₹ 20,000/- per month plus HRA (as admissible) in the ANRF-funded "JNU-PAIR network on Science for Sustainable Future" project. Initially one year, extendable annually up to the project duration (September 2025 to September 2030)

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: Central University of Punjab, Bathinda was established under Act No. 25 (2009) of Parliament. The post sits in the Partnerships for Accelerated Innovation and Research (PAIR) network titled "JNU-PAIR network on Science for Sustainable Future" under the ANRF-PAIR scheme. CUP is a spoke institution in this network. The notice calls the position purely project-based and temporary, and the project runs from September 2025 to September 2030.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens may apply. The age limit is 50 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. Bachelor's degree in any branch of Science or 3-year diploma in Engineering/Technology from a recognized University. Post-Graduation in Science with specialization in Environment/Life Sciences/Earth Sciences and allied disciplines Qualified in National Level Tests, viz. CSIR-UGC NET, GATE, etc. Field work experience Knowledge of Computers (Word/Excel/PowerPoint) The notice also expects basic knowledge of culturing and microbiological handling and an understanding of field-based crops. Candidates should be willing to travel for fieldwork and work in outdoor environments as required. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly emoluments are ₹ 20,000/- per month + HRA (as admissible). The engagement is initially for one year, subject to availability of funds. It is extendable annually up to the duration of the project, based on performance and availability of funds. The position is co-terminus with the Project. Selected candidates may register for a Ph.D. programme at CU Punjab, with admission as per the CU Punjab prospectus. They may also have an opportunity for joint supervision with JNU faculty.

content_sections.heading: CUP FIELD ASSISTANT Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist in collection, storage and analysis of soil, water and plant samples, and on-site data recording. Support field surveys and maintain field logs. Coordinate with the PI and Co-PI to ensure accurate and timely data collection. Help compile field data into structured reports for analysis and submission.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUP FIELD ASSISTANT
content_sections.text: Prepare the application in the prescribed format. Send it by email to [email protected] on or before 8 December 2026. Write "Application for the post of Field Assistant" in the subject line of the email. The notice prints no application form or CV format in the text supplied. It says applicants must show original documents at the time of interview/joining. For more details, contact Prof. Yogalakshmi KN ( [email protected] , mobile 8427706161) or Dr. Dhanya MS ( [email protected] , mobile 8872994952).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an in-person/online interview through email. The date of the interaction cum interview is 8 December 2026. The mode is offline, though requests for online interviews will be considered based on the justification provided by applicants. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
